summary: Off-roaders stuck overnight near Santa Fe Peak outside Montezuma; call for help answered by Summit County Rescue Group, with Flight for Life added to help locate possible injured parties; the party was found uninjured but their Ford Expedition had slid off the trail while trying to turn around, sitting at ~13,000 ft at a 40-45 degree angle in scree with the fuel pump run dry; SCRG extracted the occupants and referred the vehicle recovery to Colorado 4x4 R&R, which completed an ~11.5-hour winch recovery on Oct 6 (10 rigs, 20 members).
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group; Flight for Life; Colorado 4x4 Rescue & Recovery
notes: Date = the Saturday night (Sept 28, 2019) of the SAR response per the mission report; the 4x4 vehicle recovery op ran Sunday Oct 6. Occupant count unstated ('reporting parties' plural); victims=1 per the unstated-count convention. Resolves the run-134 Santa Fe Peak Expedition lead.
